mapper.select: SELECT rs.repayment_schedule_id, rs.scheduled_principal, rs.scheduled_interest, rs.paid_principal, rs.paid_interest, rs.applied_base_rate, rs.applied_additional_rate FROM repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND rs.repayment_schedule_status_id = #{overdue} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_delinquency_charge idc WHERE idc.repayment_schedule_id = rs.repayment_schedule_id AND idc.charge_date = #{chargeDate}) ORDER BY rs.installment_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO installment_delinquency_charge (repayment_schedule_id, charge_date, loan_judgment_status_id, delinquency_target_amount, delinquency_rate, delinquency_charge, paid_delinquency_charge, delinquency_status_id) VALUES (#{repaymentScheduleId}, #{chargeDate}, #{loanJudgmentStatusId}, #{delinquencyTargetAmount}, #{delinquencyRate}, #{delinquencyCharge}, 0, #{delinquencyStatusId})
